_about: Which days a Health Connect catch-up reads (#294). Shared by src/lib/health-connect.js (catchUpFrom, catchUpDue; scripts/health-connect-days.test.js) and android/.../HealthConnectDays.kt (HealthConnectDaysTest.kt), so the foreground sync and the background worker read the same days. Expected values are worked by hand: the last 7 days, back to the last finished catch-up when older, never more than 30 days; at most one catch-up an hour.

from.name: caught up today: the last 7 days
caught up yesterday: the last 7 days
away for 12 days: back to the last day covered
away for 2 months: 30 days at most
across a month and a leap day
